purpose: Universal control packet for deciding whether a formal subgoal should persist by adaptation, backtrack, pivot, quarantine, or stop.

decision_policy.persist_adapt: Continue by adaptation only when the subgoal remains target-linked and failure teaches a sharper premise, object, regime, or bridge.
decision_policy.backtrack: Move backward when the subgoal uses an object, theorem, representation, limit, or premise before it has been constructed or certified.
decision_policy.pivot: Change route family when certified obstruction repeats after adaptation without new target-relevant mathematical information.
decision_policy.quarantine: Keep the route visible as evidence or analogy when it lacks target-object identity, transfer certification, source grounding, or commitment preservation.
decision_policy.stop: Stop active-loop spending when the route has no meaningful target-object link or produces no new learning after repeated attempts.

validation_policy: Every active proof_queue, discovery_branch, revision_loop, or evidence_task route must carry this packet. Deterministic validators check shape and compatibility; generative review checks whether the rationale is mathematically substantive.
